primary_scope: All 8 fixed scenes, 20 episodes per scene, 160 per variant; unchanged.
selection_disclosure: Subsets searched after observing all outcomes for the requested ranking. These are exploratory examples, not a replacement primary evaluation or independent validation.
metric_definition: SR and SPL are means of native_mon_metrics.sr/spl across all episodes of selected whole scenes; percentages. No rounding before comparisons.
conditions_definition: Full highest of all four and specified greedy variant lowest of all four, tested separately with strict inequalities and ties allowed.
